text.ar: وَالْمُرَاقَبَةُ مَنْزِلَةٌ عَلِيَّةٌ مِنْ مَنَازِلِ السَّائِرِينَ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالدَّارِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَحَقِيقَتُهَا دَوَامُ عِلْمِ الْعَبْدِ وَتَيَقُّنِهِ بِاطِّلَاعِ الْحَقِّ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَلَى ظَاهِرِهِ وَبَاطِنِهِ، فَاسْتِدَامَتُهُ لِهَذَا الْعِلْمِ وَالْيَقِينِ هِيَ الْمُرَاقَبَةُ، وَهِيَ مُرَاقَبَةٌ لِلَّهِ عِنْدَ أَمْرِهِ لِيَفْعَلَهُ الْعَبْدُ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ حَالٍ، وَمُرَاقَبَةٌ لَهُ عِنْدَ نَهْيِهِ لِيَجْتَنِبَهُ الْعَبْدُ وَلِيَحْذَرَ مِنَ الْوُقُوعِ فِيهِ. كَمَا قَالَ الشَّاعِرُ:
text.en: Mindfulness of Allah's watching is a lofty station among the stations of those journeying to Allah and to the Home of the Hereafter. Its reality is the servant's constant knowledge and certainty that al-Haqq (the Truth), Glorified and Exalted is He, is aware of his outward and inward self; his keeping this knowledge and certainty constantly is this mindfulness. It is mindfulness of Allah at His command, so that the servant carries it out in the best manner, and mindfulness of Him at His prohibition, so that the servant avoids it and is wary of falling into it. As the poet said:

text.ar: إِذَا مَا خَلَوْتَ الدَّهْرَ يَوْماً فَلَا تَقُلْ ... خَلَوْتُ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ عَلَيَّ رَقِيبُ
text.en: If one day in all your time you find yourself alone, do not say ... “I am alone,” but say: “Over me is a Watcher.”

text.ar: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفُلُ سَاعَةً ... وَلَا أَنَّ مَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ يَغِيبُ
text.en: And never think that Allah is heedless for a single hour ... nor that anything hidden is absent from Him.

text.ar: وَهَذِهِ الْمُرَاقَبَةُ تَحْتَاجُ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ إِلَى حُضُورِ الْقَلْبِ وَاجْتِنَابِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَدَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ، وَهَذَا يُثْمِرُ سُرُورَ الْقَلْبِ وَانْشِرَاحَ الصَّدْرِ وَقُرَّةَ الْعَيْنِ بِالْقُرْبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ، وَهُوَ نَعِيمٌ مُعَجَّلٌ يَنَالُهُ الْعَبْدُ فِي دُنْيَاهُ قَبْلَ أُخْرَاهُ.
text.en: This mindfulness requires of the servant presence of heart, avoidance of heedlessness and constant remembrance. It yields joy of the heart, expansion of the breast and delight of the eye in nearness to Allah — a bliss granted in advance, which the servant attains in his worldly life before his Hereafter.

text.ar: قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَيِّمِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: «فَإِنَّ سُرُورَ الْقَلْبِ بِاللَّهِ، وَفَرَحَهُ بِهِ، وَقُرَّةَ الْعَيْنِ بِهِ، لَا يُشْبِهُهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ نَعِيمِ الدُّنْيَا الْبَتَّهَ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ نَظِيرٌ يُقَاسُ بِهِ، وَهُوَ حَالٌ مِنْ أَحْوَالِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، حَتَّى قَالَ بَعْضُ الْعَارِفِينَ: «إِنَّهُ لَتَمُرُّ بِي أَوْقَاتٌ أَقُولُ فِيهَا: إِنْ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي عَيْشٍ طَيِّبٍ». وَلَا رَيْبَ أَنَّ هَذَا السُّرُورَ يَبْعَثُهُ عَلَى دَوَامِ السَّيْرِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَبَذْلِ الْجُهْدِ فِي طَلَبِهِ، وَابْتِغَاءِ مَرْضَاتِهِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ هَذَا السُّرُورَ وَلَا شَيْئًا مِنْهُ فَلْيَتَّهِمْ إِيمَانَهُ وَأَعْمَالَهُ، فَإِنَّ لِلْإِيمَانِ حَلَاوَةً مَنْ لَمْ يَذُقْهَا فَلْيَرْجِعْ وَلْيَقْتَبِسْ نُورًا يَجِدُ بِهِ حَلَاوَةَ الْإِيمَانِ، وَقَدْ ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ ذَوْقَ طَعْمِ الْإِيمَانِ وَوَجْدَ حَلَاوَتِهِ فَذَكَرَ الذَّوْقَ وَالْوَجْدَ وَعَلَّقَهُ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَقَالَ: «ذَاقَ طَعْمَ الْإِيمَانِ مَنْ رَضِيَ بِاللَّهِ رَبّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً»[3]، وَقَالَ: «ثَلَاثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ بِهِنَّ حَلَاوَةَ الْإِيمَانِ: مَنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُحِبُّ الْمَرْءَ لَا يُحِبُّهُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ، وَمَنْ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي الْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنْقَذَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ»[4].
text.en: Ibn al-Qayyim (may Allah have mercy on him) said: “The heart's joy in Allah, its gladness in Him and the delight of the eye in Him are not resembled by anything of the bliss of this world at all; there is nothing comparable to it by which it could be measured. It is one of the states of the people of Paradise, so much so that one of those who know Allah said: ‘There are times that pass over me when I say: If the people of Paradise are in something like this, then they are truly living a good life.’ There is no doubt that this joy drives him to keep journeying constantly to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and to exert effort in seeking Him and pursuing His pleasure. Whoever does not find this joy, nor anything of it, let him suspect his faith and his deeds, for faith has a sweetness, and whoever has not tasted it should go back and seek a light by which he will find the sweetness of faith. The Prophet ﷺ mentioned tasting the flavour of faith and finding its sweetness; he mentioned tasting and finding and tied them to faith, saying: ‘He has tasted the flavour of faith who is pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad as Messenger,’[3] and he said: ‘There are three things which, whoever has them, finds through them the sweetness of faith: that Allah and His Messenger are dearer to him than anything else; that he loves a person, loving him only for Allah's sake; and that he hates to return to disbelief after Allah has saved him from it, just as he would hate to be thrown into the Fire.’[4]

text.ar: وَسَمِعْتُ شَيْخَ الْإِسْلَامِ ابْنَ تَيْمِيَّةَ قَدَّسَ اللَّهُ رُوحَهُ يَقُولُ: إِذَا لَمْ تَجِدْ لِلْعَمَلِ حَلَاوَةً فِي قَلْبِكَ وَانْشِرَاحاً فَاتَّهِمْهُ، فَإِنَّ الرَّبَّ تَعَالَى شَكُورٌ، يَعْنِي أَنَّهُ لَا بُدَّ أَنْ يُثِيبَ الْعَامِلَ عَلَى عَمَلِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا مِنْ حَلَاوَةٍ يَجِدُهَا فِي قَلْبِهِ وَقُوَّةٍ وَانْشِرَاحٍ وَقُرَّةِ عَيْنٍ؛ فَحَيْثُ لَمْ يَجِدْ ذَلِكَ فَعَمَلُهُ مَدْخُولٌ»اهـ[5].
text.en: And I heard Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah (may Allah sanctify his soul) say: ‘If you do not find sweetness and expansion in your heart from a deed, then suspect it, for the Lord, the Exalted, is Shakur (Most Appreciative).’ He meant that He must reward the doer for his deed in this world with sweetness he finds in his heart, and with strength, expansion and delight of the eye; so wherever he does not find that, his deed is flawed.” End quote.[5]

text.ar: «الْحَقُّ الْوَاضِحُ الْمُبِينُ» (ص/ ٣١ ـ ٣٢).
text.en: *al-Haqq al-Wadih al-Mubin* (pp. 31–32).

text.ar: (رَقْمُ: ٨) مِنْ حَدِيثِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ مُطَوَّلاً.
text.en: (no. 8), from the hadith of ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him), in full length.

text.ar: رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ (رَقْمُ: ٣٤) مِنْ حَدِيثِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
text.en: Narrated by Muslim (no. 34) from the hadith of al-‘Abbas ibn ‘Abd al-Muttalib (may Allah be pleased with him).

text.ar: رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ (رَقْمُ: ١٦)، وَمُسْلِمٌ (رَقْمُ: ٤٣) مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
text.en: Narrated by al-Bukhari (no. 16) and Muslim (no. 43) from the hadith of Anas (may Allah be pleased with him).

text.ar: «مَدَارِجُ السَّالِكِينَ» (٣/ ٦٧ ـ ٦٨).
text.en: *Madarij as-Salikin* (3/67–68).

title.en: al-Muhaymin, al-Muhit, al-Muqit, al-Wasi‘ (the Overseer, the All-Encompassing, the Sustainer, the All-Embracing)

text.ar: أَمَّا «الْمُهَيْمِنُ» فَقَدْ وَرَدَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ وَاحِدٍ وَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ ٱلۡمُهَيۡمِنُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ﴾ [الْحَشْرِ: ٢٣].
text.en: As for “al-Muhaymin” (the Overseer), it has come in only one place, namely the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴾He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity: the King, the Most Holy, the Perfect Peace, the Granter of security, the Overseer, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glorified is Allah above what they associate with Him﴿ [al-Hashr 59:23].

text.ar: وَمَعْنَى «الْمُهَيْمِنِ» أَيْ: الْمُطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَفَايَا الْأُمُورِ، وَخَبَايَا الصُّدُورِ، الَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا، الشَّاهِدُ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ، الرَّقِيبُ عَلَيْهِمْ فِيمَا يَصْدُرُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ، لَا يَغِيبُ عَنْهُ مِنْ أَفْعَالِهِمْ شَيْءٌ، وَلَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ.
text.en: “Al-Muhaymin” (the Overseer) means: the One aware of the hidden aspects of affairs and the secrets of the breasts, who encompasses everything in knowledge; the Witness over creation in their deeds; the Watcher over them in whatever word or deed comes from them. Nothing of their deeds is absent from Him, and not even an atom's weight on earth or in heaven escapes Him.

text.ar: وَأَمَّا «الْمُحِيطُ» فَقَدْ وَرَدَ فِي عِدَّةِ مَوَاضِعَ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّحِيطٗا﴾ [النِّسَاءِ: ١٢٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ﴾ [آلِ عِمْرَانَ: ١٢٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ١٩].
text.en: As for “al-Muhit” (the All-Encompassing), it has come in several places. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah is ever encompassing of all things﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:126]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Indeed, Allah encompasses what they do﴿ [Al ‘Imran 3:120]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And Allah encompasses the disbelievers﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:19].

text.ar: وَهُوَ اسْمٌ دَالٌّ عَلَى إِحَاطَةِ اللَّهِ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا وَقُدْرَةً وَقَهْرًا، كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِۚ﴾ [الْإِسْرَاءِ: ٦٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا﴾ [الطَّلَاقِ: ١٢]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا﴾ [الْجِنِّ: ٢٨].
text.en: It is a name indicating that Allah encompasses everything in knowledge, power and subjugation, as Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And when We said to you, “Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people”﴿ [al-Isra' 17:60]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾That you may know that Allah has power over all things and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge﴿ [at-Talaq 65:12]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number﴿ [al-Jinn 72:28].

text.ar: وَإِحَاطَتُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ بِالْمَخْلُوقَاتِ إِحَاطَةُ عِلْمٍ، فَلَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ، وَإِحَاطَةُ قُدْرَةٍ فَلَا يُعْجِزُهُ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَإِحَاطَةُ قَهْرٍ فَلَا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى فَوْتِهِ أَوِ الْفِرَارِ مِنْهُ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ﴾ [الرَّحْمَنِ: ٣٣]، أَيْ: لَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ هَرَبًا مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ وَقَدَرِهِ لِأَنَّهُ مُحِيطٌ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً وَقُدْرَةً وَقَهْراً.
text.en: His encompassing of created things (Glorified is He) is an encompassing of knowledge, so that not even an atom's weight of His creation escapes Him; an encompassing of power, so that nothing on earth or in heaven is beyond Him; and an encompassing of subjugation, so that they cannot evade Him or flee from Him. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except with authority﴿ [ar-Rahman 55:33], meaning: you cannot flee from Allah's command and decree, because He encompasses everything in knowledge, power and subjugation.

text.ar: وَأَمَّا «الْمُقِيتُ» فَقَدْ وَرَدَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿مَّن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةٗ سَيِّئَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفۡلٞ مِّنۡهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقِيتٗا﴾ [النِّسَاءِ: ٨٥]، قِيلَ فِي مَعْنَاهُ: الَّذِي أَوْصَلَ إِلَى كُلِّ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ مَا بِهِ تَقْتَاتُ، وَأَوْصَلَ إِلَيْهَا أَرْزَاقَهَا، وَصَرَّفَهَا كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ وَحَمْدِهِ، أَيْ: أَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الَّذِي يُنْزِلُ الْأَقْوَاتَ لِلْخَلْقِ وَيَقْسِمُ أَرْزَاقَهُمْ صَغِيرِهِمْ وَكَبِيرِهِمْ، غَنِيِّهِمْ وَفَقِيرِهِمْ، قَوِيِّهِمْ وَضَعِيفِهِمْ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَيَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلّٞ فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ﴾ [هُودٍ: ٦]، وَكُلُّ هَذِهِ الْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَقْوَاتِ قَدَّرَهَا سُبْحَانَهُ عِنْدَ خَلْقِهِ لِلْأَرْضِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ مِن فَوۡقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقۡوَٰتَهَا فِيٓ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَيَّامٖ سَوَآءٗ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ﴾ [فُصِّلَتْ: ١٠]، أَيْ: قَدَّرَ فِيهَا مَا يَحْتَاجُهُ أَهْلُهَا مِنَ الْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَمَاكِنِ الَّتِي تُزْرَعُ وَتُغْرَسُ وَمَا يَصْلُحُ لِمَعَاشِهِمْ مِنَ التِّجَارَاتِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ وَالْمَنَافِعِ.
text.en: As for “al-Muqit” (the Sustainer), it has come in only one place, namely the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴾Whoever intercedes with a good intercession will have a share of it, and whoever intercedes with an evil intercession will have a portion of it. And Allah is ever, over all things, a Sustainer﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:85]. It has been said regarding its meaning: the One who conveys to all existing things that by which they are nourished, conveys to them their provisions, and disposes of them however He wills by His wisdom and praise. That is, He (Glorified is He) is the One who sends down sustenance for creation and apportions their provisions, the small and the great among them, the rich and the poor, the strong and the weak. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and its place of deposit. All is in a clear record﴿ [Hud 11:6]. All these provisions and sustenance He (Glorified is He) measured out when He created the earth. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And He placed on it firm mountains rising above it, and blessed it, and determined therein its sustenance in four days, equal for those who ask﴿ [Fussilat 41:10], meaning: He determined in it what its inhabitants need of provisions, of places for sowing and planting, and of what is suitable for their livelihood of trades, trees and benefits.

text.ar: وَذُكِرَ فِي مَعْنَى «الْمُقِيتِ» مَعَانٍ أُخْرَى، قَالَ ابْنُ كَثِيرٍ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: «وَقَوْلُهُ: ﴿وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقِيتٗا﴾ [النِّسَاءِ: ٨٥]، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَطَاءٌ وَعَطِيَّةُ وَقَتَادَةُ وَمَطَرٌ الْوَرَّاقُ: ﴿مُّقِيتٗا﴾ أَيْ: حَفِيظاً، وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: شَهِيداً، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنْهُ: حَسِيبًا، وَقَالَ سَعِيدُ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ وَالسُّدِّيُّ وَابْنُ زَيْدٍ: قَدِيرًا، وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ: الْمُقِيتُ: الْوَاصِبُ، وَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ: الْمُقِيتُ: الرَّزَّاقُ»[1].
text.en: Other meanings have also been mentioned for “al-Muqit” (the Sustainer). Ibn Kathir (may Allah have mercy on him) said: “His saying: ﴾And Allah is ever, over all things, a Sustainer﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:85] — Ibn ‘Abbas, ‘Ata', ‘Atiyyah, Qatadah and Matar al-Warraq said: ﴾Muqit﴿ means: Preserver. Mujahid said: Witness, and in another narration from him: Reckoner. Sa‘id ibn Jubayr, as-Suddi and Ibn Zayd said: All-Powerful. ‘Abdullah ibn Kathir said: al-Muqit is the Ever-Constant. Ad-Dahhak said: al-Muqit is the Provider.”[1]

text.ar: وَلَا يَمْنَعُ أَنْ يَكُونَ هَذَا الِاسْمُ مُتَنَاوِلاً لِجَمِيعِ هَذِهِ الْمَعَانِي، بِأَنْ يَكُونَ مَعْنَاهُ: الَّذِي أَحَاطَ عِلْمًا بِالْعِبَادِ وَأَحْوَالِهِمْ، وَمَا يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَيْهِ، وَأَحَاطَ بِهِمْ قُدْرَةً، فَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَتَوَلَّى حِفْظَهُمْ وَرِزْقَهُمْ وَإِمْدَادَهُمْ، الَّذِي يُقِيتُ الْأَبْدَانَ بِالْأَطْعِمَةِ وَالْأَرْزَاقِ، وَيُقِيتُ قُلُوبَ مَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، كَمَا قِيلَ:
text.en: There is nothing to prevent this name from encompassing all these meanings, such that its meaning is: the One who encompasses His servants in knowledge — their states and what they need — and encompasses them in power, for He has power over all things; who has taken charge of preserving them, providing for them and supplying them; who nourishes bodies with food and provision, and nourishes the hearts of whomever He wills of His servants with knowledge and faith. As it has been said:

text.ar: فَقُوتُ الرُّوحِ أَرْوَاحُ الْمَعَانِي ... وَلَيْسَ بِأَنْ طَعِمْتَ وَأَنْ شَرِبْتَا
text.en: The nourishment of the soul is the spirit of meanings ... not that you have eaten and that you have drunk.

text.ar: وَأَمَّا «الْوَاسِعُ» فَقَدْ تَكَرَّرَ فِي عِدَّةِ مَوَاضِعَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ يُؤۡتِي مُلۡكَهُۥ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٤٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَأَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّواْ فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ١١٥].
text.en: As for “al-Wasi‘” (the All-Embracing), it recurs in several places in the Qur'an. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah gives His kingdom to whom He wills. And Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:247]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾So wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:115].

text.ar: وَمَعْنَاهُ: الْوَاسِعُ الصِّفَاتِ وَالنُّعُوتِ، وَمُتَعَلَّقَاتِهَا، بِحَيْثُ لَا يُحْصِي أَحَدٌ ثَنَاءً عَلَيْهِ، بَلْ هُوَ كَمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَاسِعُ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالسُّلْطَانِ وَالْمُلْكِ، وَاسِعُ الْفَضْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ، عَظِيمُ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ.
text.en: It means: the One vast in His attributes and descriptions and in all that they relate to, such that no one can fully enumerate His praise; rather, He is as He has praised Himself. He is vast in greatness, authority and dominion, vast in bounty and kindness, and immense in generosity and noble giving.

text.ar: قَالَ تَعَالَى فِي بَيَانِ سَعَةِ عِلْمِهِ: ﴿وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًاۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ [الْأَنْعَامِ: ٨٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمٗا﴾ [طَٰهَٰ: ٩٨].
text.en: Allah the Exalted says, making clear the vastness of His knowledge: ﴾My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; will you not then take heed?﴿ [al-An‘am 6:80], and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Your deity is only Allah, other than whom there is no deity. He encompasses all things in knowledge﴿ [Ta Ha 20:98].

text.ar: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي بَيَانِ سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِهِ: ﴿وَرَحۡمَتِي وَسِعَتۡ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۚ﴾ [الْأَعْرَافِ: ١٥٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا﴾ [غَافِرٍ: ٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمۡ ذُو رَحۡمَةٖ وَٰسِعَةٖ﴾ [الْأَنْعَامِ: ١٤٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي بَيَانِ سَعَةِ رِزْقِهِ: ﴿وَإِن يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغۡنِ ٱللَّهُ كُلّٗا مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعًا حَكِيمٗا﴾ [النِّسَاءِ: ١٣٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [آلِ عِمْرَانَ: ٧٣]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِن يَكُونُواْ فُقَرَآءَ يُغۡنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [النُّورِ: ٣٢].
text.en: And He, the Exalted, says, making clear the vastness of His mercy: ﴾And My mercy encompasses all things﴿ [al-A‘raf 7:156]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge﴿ [Ghafir 40:7]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾So if they deny you, say: Your Lord is the Possessor of vast mercy﴿ [al-An‘am 6:147]. And He, the Exalted, says, making clear the vastness of His provision: ﴾But if they separate, Allah will enrich each of them from His abundance. And Allah is ever All-Embracing, All-Wise﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:130]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Say: Indeed, all bounty is in the hand of Allah; He grants it to whom He wills. And Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [Al ‘Imran 3:73]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾If they are poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty. And Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [an-Nur 24:32].

text.ar: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي بَيَانِ سَعَةِ مَغْفِرَتِهِ: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ مِّنۡهُ وَفَضۡلٗاۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٦٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ﴾ [النَّجْمِ: ٣٢]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾ [الزُّمَرِ: ٥٣]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي بَيَانِ سَعَةِ ثَوَابِهِ: ﴿مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنۢبَتَتۡ سَبۡعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنۢبُلَةٖ مِّاْئَةُ حَبَّةٖۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُضَٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٦١].
text.en: And He, the Exalted, says, making clear the vastness of His forgiveness: ﴾And Allah promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:268]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness﴿ [an-Najm 53:32]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful﴿ [az-Zumar 39:53]. And He, the Exalted, says, making clear the vastness of His reward: ﴾The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed that grows seven ears; in each ear is a hundred seeds. And Allah multiplies for whom He wills. And Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:261].

text.ar: وَمِنْ شَوَاهِدِ اسْمِهِ «الْوَاسِعِ» أَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَسَّعَ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ فِي دِينِهِمْ فَلَمْ يُكَلِّفْهُمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي وُسْعِهِمْ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٨٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلۡيُسۡرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلۡعُسۡرَ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ١٨٥]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمۡۚ وَخُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ ضَعِيفٗا﴾ [النِّسَاءِ: ٢٨].
text.en: Among the signs of His name “al-Wasi‘” (the All-Embracing) is that He (Glorified is He) has made their religion spacious for His servants and has not burdened them with what is beyond their capacity. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:286]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Allah intends ease for you and does not intend hardship for you﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:185]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Allah wants to lighten your burden, and mankind was created weak﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:28].

text.ar: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا مَنَّ وَيَسَّرَ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى.
text.en: So to Allah belongs all praise for what He has bestowed and made easy — abundant, good and blessed praise, as our Lord loves and is pleased with.
*Tafsir Ibn Kathir* (2/324). See also *Tafsir at-Tabari* (7/272).

text.ar: قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ﴾ [هُودٍ: ٥٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ﴾ [سَبَأَ: ٢١]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٖ﴾ [الشُّورَى: ٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ حَٰفِظٗاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ﴾ [يُوسُفَ: ٦٤]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ﴾ [الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: ٨٢]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ﴾ [الْحِجْرِ: ٩].
text.en: Allah the Exalted says: ﴾Indeed, my Lord is Preserver over all things﴿ [Hud 11:57]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And your Lord is Preserver over all things﴿ [Saba' 34:21]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And those who take protectors besides Him — Allah is Preserver over them, and you are not a guardian over them﴿ [ash-Shura 42:6]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾But Allah is the best Preserver, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful﴿ [Yusuf 12:64]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And We were guarding over them﴿ [al-Anbiya' 21:82]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its preserver﴿ [al-Hijr 15:9].

text.ar: وَهَذَانِ الِاسْمَانِ الْعَظِيمَانِ دَالَّانِ عَلَى أَنَّ اللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ مَوْصُوفٌ بِالْحِفْظِ، وَهَذَا الْوَصْفُ يَتَنَاوَلُ أَمْرَيْنِ:
text.en: These two great names indicate that Allah (Glorified is He) is described with preserving, and this description includes two matters:

text.ar: الْأَوَّلُ: الْحِفْظُ بِعِلْمِهِ جَمِيعَ الْمَعْلُومَاتِ؛ فَلَا يَغِيبُ عَنْهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْهَا، وَفِي مُقَابِلِ ذَلِكَ النِّسْيَانُ، وَقَدْ نَزَّهَ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ عَنْهُ لِكَمَالِ عِلْمِهِ وَحِفْظِهِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيّٗا﴾ [مَرْيَمَ: ٦٤]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى﴾ [طَٰهَٰ: ٥٢]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَحۡصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُۚ﴾ [الْمُجَادَلَةِ: ٦].
text.en: The first: preserving, by His knowledge, all that is known, so that nothing of it is absent from Him. Its opposite is forgetfulness, and Allah has declared Himself free of it because of the perfection of His knowledge and preserving. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And your Lord is never forgetful﴿ [Maryam 19:64]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾He said: Its knowledge is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets﴿ [Ta Ha 20:52]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Allah has kept account of it, while they forgot it﴿ [al-Mujadilah 58:6].

text.ar: فَهُوَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَحْفَظُ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ أَعْمَالَهُمْ، وَيُحْصِي عَلَيْهِمْ أَقْوَالَهُمْ، وَيَعْلَمُ نِيَّاتِهِمْ وَمَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ، وَلَا تَغِيبُ عَنْهُ غَائِبَةٌ وَلَا تَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ خَافِيَةٌ، وَكَتَبَ ذَلِكَ فِي اللَّوْحِ الْمَحْفُوظِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ (٥٢) وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ﴾ [الْقَمَرِ: ٥٢ ـ ٥٣].
text.en: He, Blessed and Exalted is He, keeps a record of creation's deeds against them, counts their words against them, and knows their intentions and what their breasts conceal. Nothing absent is absent from Him, and nothing hidden is hidden from Him, and He has written all of that in the Preserved Tablet. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And everything they did is in the written records (52), and every small and great thing is inscribed﴿ [al-Qamar 54:52–53].

text.ar: وَوَكَّلَ سُبْحَانَهُ مَلَائِكَةً كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ يَحْفَظُونَ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ أَعْمَالَهُمْ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ﴾ [الطَّارِقِ: ٤]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ (١٠) كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ (١١) يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ﴾ [الِانْفِطَارِ: ١٠ ـ ١٢].
text.en: And He (Glorified is He) has appointed noble angels, recorders, who keep a record of the servants' deeds. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾There is no soul but that over it is a guardian﴿ [at-Tariq 86:4], and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And indeed, over you are guardians (10), noble, recording (11); they know whatever you do﴿ [al-Infitar 82:10–12].

text.ar: وَهَذَا الْمَعْنَى مِنْ حِفْظِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ يَقْتَضِي إِحَاطَةَ عِلْمِهِ بِأَحْوَالِ الْعِبَادِ كُلِّهَا؛ ظَاهِرِهَا وَبَاطِنِهَا، سِرِّهَا وَعَلَنِهَا، وَكِتَابَتَهَا فِي اللَّوْحِ الْمَحْفُوظِ وَفِي الصُّحُفِ الَّتِي فِي أَيْدِي الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعِلْمَهُ بِمَقَادِيرِهَا وَكَمَالِهَا وَنَقْصِهَا وَمَقَادِيرِ جَزَائِهَا فِي الثَّوَابِ وَالْعِقَابِ، ثُمَّ مُجَازَاتَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا بِفَضْلِهِ وَعَدْلِهِ.
text.en: This meaning of His preserving (Glorified is He) entails that His knowledge encompasses all the states of the servants — outward and inward, secret and open — and that they are written in the Preserved Tablet and in the scrolls held by the angels; His knowledge of their measures, their completeness and deficiency, and the measure of their recompense in reward and punishment; and then His recompensing them for them by His bounty and His justice.

text.ar: الثَّانِي: أَنَّهُ تَعَالَى الْحَافِظُ لِلْمَخْلُوقَاتِ مِنْ سَمَاءٍ وَأَرْضٍ وَمَا فِيهِمَا، لِتَبْقَى مُدَّةَ بَقَائِهَا، فَلَا تَزُولُ وَلَا تَدْثُرُ وَلَا تَمِيدُ وَلَا يَسْقُطُ شَيْءٌ عَلَى شَيْءٍ، وَلَا يُثْقِلُهُ وَلَا يُعْجِزُهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٥٥]، يَحْفَظُ سُبْحَانَهُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦٓۚ﴾ [الْحَجِّ: ٦٥]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفٗا مَّحۡفُوظٗاۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ﴾ [الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: ٣٢]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَن تَزُولَاۚ﴾ [فَاطِرٍ: ٤١].
text.en: The second: that He, the Exalted, is the Preserver of created things — the heaven, the earth and all that is in them — so that they remain for as long as they are to remain. They do not cease, decay or sway, nor does anything fall upon anything else, and none of that weighs upon Him or is beyond Him, as Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And preserving them does not tire Him﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:255]. He (Glorified is He) keeps the sky from falling upon the earth. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾And He holds back the sky from falling upon the earth, except by His permission﴿ [al-Hajj 22:65]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And We made the sky a protected ceiling, yet they turn away from its signs﴿ [al-Anbiya' 21:32]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease﴿ [Fatir 35:41].

text.ar: وَتَكَفَّلَ سُبْحَانَهُ بِحِفْظِ كِتَابِهِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ﴾ [الْحِجْرِ: ٩]، فَلَا يَطُولُهُ تَحْرِيفٌ، وَلَا يَلْحَقُهُ تَبْدِيلٌ، وَلَا يُغَيَّرُ فِيهِ حَرْفٌ، وَمَعَ تَطَاوُلِ الْأَيَّامِ وَامْتِدَادِ الزَّمَانِ بَقِيَ الْقُرْآنُ كَمَا هُوَ، وَبَقِيَتْ آيَاتُهُ كَمَا أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ ﷺ، وَسَيَظَلُّ مَحْفُوظاً بِحِفْظِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ.
text.en: And He (Glorified is He) has taken it upon Himself to preserve His Mighty Book. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its preserver﴿ [al-Hijr 15:9]. So no distortion reaches it, no alteration touches it, and not a single letter of it is changed. Despite the passing of days and the long stretch of time, the Qur'an has remained as it is, and its verses have remained as Allah revealed them to His Prophet ﷺ, and it will remain preserved by the preservation of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

text.ar: وَمِنْ مَعَانِي هَذَا الِاسْمِ أَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ الْحَافِظُ لِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَحِفْظُهُ لَهُمْ نَوْعَانِ عَامٌّ وَخَاصٌّ.
text.en: Among the meanings of this name is that He (Glorified is He) is the Preserver of His servants from everything they dislike, and His preserving of them is of two kinds: general and specific.

text.ar: فَالْعَامُّ: حِفْظُهُ لَهُمْ بِتَيْسِيرِهِ لَهُمُ الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّرَابَ وَالْهَوَاءَ، وَهِدَايَتِهِمْ إِلَى مَصَالِحِهِمْ، وَإِلَى مَا قَدَّرَ لَهُمْ وَقَضَى لَهُمْ مِنْ ضَرُورَاتٍ وَحَاجَاتٍ وَهِيَ الْهِدَايَةُ الْعَامَّةُ الَّتِي قَالَ عَنْهَا سُبْحَانَهُ: ﴿ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ﴾ [طَٰهَٰ: ٥٠]، وَحِفْظُهُمْ بِدَفْعِ أَصْنَافِ الْمَكَارِهِ وَالْمَضَارِّ وَالشُّرُورِ عَنْهُمْ، وَهَذَا الْحِفْظُ يَشْتَرِكُ فِيهِ الْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرُ، بَلِ الْحَيَوَانَاتُ وَغَيْرُهَا، وَقَدْ وَكَلَ بِبَنِي آدَمَ مَلَائِكَةً يَحْفَظُونَهُمْ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ، كَمَا قَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ: ﴿لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٞ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ يَحۡفَظُونَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ﴾ [الرَّعْدِ: ١١]، أَيْ: يَدْفَعُونَ عَنْهُ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ كُلَّ مَا يَضُرُّهُ مِمَّا هُوَ بِصَدَدِ أَنْ يَضُرَّهُ لَوْلَا حِفْظُ اللَّهِ.
text.en: The general: His preserving them by making food, drink and air easily available to them, and by guiding them to their interests and to the necessities and needs He has decreed and ordained for them. This is the general guidance of which He (Glorified is He) said: ﴾The One who gave everything its form and then guided it﴿ [Ta Ha 20:50]. It also includes His preserving them by repelling all kinds of hardship, harm and evil from them. In this preserving the righteous and the wicked share alike — indeed, even the animals and others. He has appointed angels over the children of Adam who guard them by Allah's command, as He (Glorified is He) said: ﴾For him are successive angels, before him and behind him, who guard him by the command of Allah﴿ [ar-Ra‘d 13:11], meaning: by Allah's command they repel from him everything that would harm him, of what was on the verge of harming him were it not for Allah's preserving.

text.ar: وَالْخَاصُّ: حِفْظُهُ لِأَوْلِيَائِهِ ـ إِضَافَةً إِلَى مَا تَقَدَّمَ ـ بِحِفْظِ إِيمَانِهِمْ مِنَ الشُّبَهِ الْمُضِلَّةِ وَالْفِتَنِ الْجَارِفَةِ وَالشَّهَوَاتِ الْمُهْلِكَةِ، فَيُعَافِيهِمْ مِنْهَا، وَيَحْفَظُهُمْ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ فَيَنْصُرُهُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَدْفَعُ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدَ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَمَكْرَهُمْ، كَمَا قَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۗ﴾ [الْحَجِّ: ٣٨]، وَعَلَى حَسَبِ مَا عِنْدَ الْعَبْدِ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ تَكُونُ مُدَافَعَةُ اللَّهِ عَنْهُ.
text.en: The specific: His preserving His allies — in addition to what has preceded — by preserving their faith from misleading doubts, sweeping trials and destructive desires, so that He keeps them safe from these; and by preserving them from their enemies among the jinn and mankind, granting them victory over them and repelling from them the plots and schemes of the enemies, as He (Glorified is He) said: ﴾Indeed, Allah defends those who believe﴿ [al-Hajj 22:38]. Allah's defence of the servant is in proportion to the faith the servant has.

text.ar: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ كَمَا فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: «احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ». رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ[1]، أَيْ: احْفَظْ أَوَامِرَهُ بِالِامْتِثَالِ، وَنَوَاهِيَهُ بِالِاجْتِنَابِ، وَحُدُودَهُ بِعَدَمِ تَعَدِّيهَا، يَحْفَظْكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَدِينِكَ وَمَالِكَ وَوَلَدِكَ وَفِي جَمِيعِ مَا آتَاكَ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ.
text.en: This is why the Prophet ﷺ said, as in his advice to Ibn ‘Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both): “Guard Allah and He will guard you.” Narrated by Ahmad and at-Tirmidhi.[1] That is: guard His commands by carrying them out, His prohibitions by avoiding them, and His limits by not overstepping them, and He will guard you in yourself, your religion, your wealth, your children, and in all that Allah has given you of His bounty.

text.ar: وَقَدْ مَدَحَ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ يَحْفَظُونَ حُقُوقَهُ وَحُدُودَهُ فَقَالَ: ﴿وَٱلۡحَٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ﴾ [التَّوْبَةِ: ١١٢]، وَقَالَ: ﴿هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ (٣٢) مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ﴾ [ق: ٣٢ ـ ٣٣]، وَيَدْخُلُ فِي هَذَا حِفْظُ التَّوْحِيدِ مِنْ نَوَاقِضِهِ وَنَوَاقِصِهِ؛ إِذْ هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُحْفَظَ وَيُصَانَ، وَحِفْظُ شَعَائِرِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَلَا سِيَّمَا الصَّلَاةُ ﴿حَٰفِظُواْ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلۡوُسۡطَىٰ وَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ قَٰنِتِينَ﴾ [الْبَقَرَةِ: ٢٣٨]، وَحِفْظُ السَّمْعِ وَالْبَصَرِ وَالْفُؤَادِ ﴿إِنَّ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡبَصَرَ وَٱلۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔولٗا﴾ [الْإِسْرَاءِ: ٣٦]، وَحِفْظُ الْفُرُوجِ ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ (٥) إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ (٦) فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ﴾ [الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: ٥ ـ ٧]، إِلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ بِحِفْظِهِ، وَجَعَلَ ثَوَابَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ حِفْظَهُ لَهُمْ وَدِفَاعَهُ عَنْهُمْ وَوِقَايَتَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ ضُرٍّ وَبَلَاءٍ.
text.en: Allah has praised His servants who guard His rights and His limits, saying: ﴾And those who guard the limits of Allah. And give good tidings to the believers﴿ [at-Tawbah 9:112], and saying: ﴾This is what you are promised — for everyone who constantly turned back to Allah and guarded His covenant (32), who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart turning to Him in repentance﴿ [Qaf 50:32–33]. Included in this is guarding Tawheed from what nullifies it and what diminishes it, since it is the greatest thing that ought to be guarded and protected; guarding the rites of Islam, especially the prayer: ﴾Guard strictly the prayers, and the middle prayer, and stand before Allah in devout obedience﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:238]; guarding the hearing, the sight and the heart: ﴾Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart — about all of these one will be questioned﴿ [al-Isra' 17:36]; and guarding the private parts: ﴾And those who guard their private parts (5), except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for then they are not to be blamed (6). But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors﴿ [al-Mu'minun 23:5–7]; along with the other things that Allah has commanded His servants to guard. And He has made their reward for that His preserving them, His defending them, and His protecting them from every harm and affliction.

text.ar: وَلَا حَافِظَ لِلْعَبْدِ فِي دِينِهِ وَدُنْيَاهُ وَفِي أَيِّ أَمْرٍ مِنْ أُمُورِهِ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ﴿فَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ حَٰفِظٗاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ﴾ [يُوسُفَ: ٦٤].
text.en: The servant has no preserver in his religion, in his worldly life, or in any of his affairs except Allah: ﴾But Allah is the best Preserver, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful﴿ [Yusuf 12:64].

text.ar: وَكَمْ هُوَ جَمِيلٌ بِالْعَبْدِ مَعَ حِفْظِهِ لِمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ بِحِفْظِهِ أَنْ يَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِالدُّعَاءِ أَنْ يُعَافِيَهُ فِي دِينِهِ وَدُنْيَاهُ وَأَنْ يَحْفَظَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ وَبَلَاءٍ، وَفِي «الْمُسْنَدِ»[2] وَغَيْرِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: «لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي».
text.en: How beautiful it is for the servant — while guarding what Allah has commanded him to guard — to turn to Allah in supplication, asking Him to grant him well-being in his religion and his worldly life, and to preserve him from every evil and affliction. In *al-Musnad*[2] and elsewhere, from Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both), who said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never used to leave these supplications in the evening and in the morning: ‘O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion and my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from in front of me and from behind me, from my right and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.’”

text.ar: «مُسْنَدُ الْإِمَامِ أَحْمَدَ» (١/ ٢٩٣)، وَ«جَامِعُ التِّرْمِذِيِّ» (رَقْم: ٢٥١٦) وَغَيْرُهُمَا. وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ: حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ.
text.en: *Musnad al-Imam Ahmad* (1/293), *Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi* (no. 2516) and others. At-Tirmidhi said: “Hasan sahih (good and authentic).”

text.ar: (٢/ ٢٥) وَإِسْنَادُهُ صَحِيحٌ.
text.en: (2/25). Its chain is authentic.

title.en: al-Waliyy, al-Mawla (the Protecting Ally, the Patron)

text.ar: وَهُمَا اسْمَانِ تَكَرَّرَ وُرُودُهُمَا فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ، قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ﴾ [الشُّورَى: ٩]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ﴾ [الشُّورَى: ٢٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ نَصِيرٗا﴾ [النِّسَاء: ٤٥]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ﴾ [الْحَجّ: ٧٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلنَّٰصِرِينَ﴾ [آلِ عِمْرَانَ: ١٥٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ﴾ [التَّحْرِيم: ٢].
text.en: These are two names that recur in the Noble Qur'an. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾Or have they taken protectors besides Him? But Allah — He is the Protecting Ally, and He gives life to the dead, and He has power over all things﴿ [ash-Shura 42:9]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protecting Ally, the Praiseworthy﴿ [ash-Shura 42:28]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And sufficient is Allah as an Ally, and sufficient is Allah as a Helper﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:45]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And hold fast to Allah. He is your Patron; and what an excellent Patron, and what an excellent Helper﴿ [al-Hajj 22:78]; He, the Exalted, says: ﴾Rather, Allah is your Patron, and He is the best of helpers﴿ [Al ‘Imran 3:150]; and He, the Exalted, says: ﴾And Allah is your Patron, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise﴿ [at-Tahrim 66:2].

text.ar: وَوِلَايَةُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَوَلِّيهِ لِعِبَادِهِ نَوْعَانِ:
text.en: Allah's guardianship and His taking charge of His servants are of two kinds:

text.ar: وِلَايَةٌ عَامَّةٌ: وَهِيَ تَصْرِيفُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَدْبِيرُهُ لِجَمِيعِ الْكَائِنَاتِ، وَتَقْدِيرُهُ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ مَا يُرِيدُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَشَرٍّ، وَنَفْعٍ وَضَرٍّ، وَإِثْبَاتُ مَعَانِي الْمُلْكِ كُلِّهِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى، وَأَنَّ الْعِبَادَ كُلَّهُمْ طَوْعُ تَدْبِيرِهِ لَا خُرُوجَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ نُفُوذِ مَشِيئَتِهِ وَشُمُولِ قُدْرَتِهِ، وَهَذَا أَمْرٌ يَشْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنَ وَالْكَافِرَ، وَالْبَرَّ وَالْفَاجِرَ، يَدُلُّ لِهَذَا قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَهُوَ أَسۡرَعُ ٱلۡحَٰسِبِينَ﴾ [الْأَنْعَام: ٦٢]، وَقَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُنَالِكَ تَبۡلُواْ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّآ أَسۡلَفَتۡۚ وَرُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ﴾ [يُونُس: ٣٠].
text.en: General guardianship: this is His (Glorified is He) disposing and managing of all beings, and His decreeing for the servants whatever He wills of good and evil, benefit and harm; it is the affirmation of every meaning of dominion for Allah the Exalted, and that all the servants are subject to His management, none of them able to escape the reach of His will and the all-inclusiveness of His power. This includes the believer and the disbeliever, the righteous and the wicked. Evidence for this is the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴾Then they are returned to Allah, their true Patron. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of reckoners﴿ [al-An‘am 6:62], and His saying, exalted is He: ﴾There, every soul will be put to the test for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah, their true Patron, and whatever they used to invent will have strayed from them﴿ [Yunus 10:30].

text.ar: وَمَعْنَى كَوْنِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ مَوْلَى الْكَافِرِينَ أَيْ: أَنَّهُ مَالِكُهُمْ، الْمُتَصَرِّفُ فِيهِمْ بِمَا شَاءَ، وَلَا يُعَارِضُ هَذَا قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ﴾ [مُحَمَّد: ١١]؛ إِذِ الْوِلَايَةُ الْمَنْفِيَّةُ هُنَا هِيَ وِلَايَةُ الْمَحَبَّةِ وَالتَّوْفِيقِ وَالنَّصْرِ وَالتَّأْيِيدِ، وَهِيَ خَاصَّةٌ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَلَيْسَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْهَا نَصِيبٌ، بَلْ حَظُّهُمُ الْخُسْرَانُ، وَنَصِيبُهُمُ الْحِرْمَانُ، وَوَلِيُّهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ، وَمَوْلَاهُمُ النَّارُ، وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ﴾ [النَّحْل: ٦٣]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنكُمۡ فِدۡيَةٞ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ مَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ هِيَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ﴾ [الْحَدِيد: ١٥].
text.en: The meaning of His being, Glorified is He, the Mawla (Master) of the disbelievers is that He is their Owner, who disposes of them as He wills. This does not conflict with His saying, Exalted is He: ﴾That is because Allah is the Protector of those who believe, and the disbelievers have no protector﴿ [Muhammad 47:11], for the walayah (protective friendship) negated here is the walayah of love, granting success, help and support. It belongs exclusively to the believers, and the disbelievers have no share in it; rather, their lot is loss, their portion is deprivation, their ally is Satan, and their keeper is the Fire, and what an evil destination! He the Exalted says: ﴾But Satan made their deeds seem fair to them, so he is their ally today, and theirs is a painful punishment﴿ [an-Nahl 16:63], and He the Exalted says: ﴾So today no ransom will be taken from you, nor from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire; it is your keeper (mawla), and what an evil destination!﴿ [al-Hadid 57:15].

text.ar: النَّوْعُ الثَّانِي: الْوِلَايَةُ الْخَاصَّةُ وَالتَّوَلِّي الْخَاصُّ؛ وَهَذَا أَكْثَرُ مَا يَرِدُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ وَفِي السُّنَّةِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ، وَهِيَ وِلَايَةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ وَتَوَلٍّ كَرِيمٌ، اخْتَصَّ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَحِزْبَهُ الْمُطِيعِينَ، وَأَوْلِيَاءَهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ.
text.en: The second type: the special walayah and the special taking-into-care. This is what occurs most often in the Noble Qur'an and in the Prophetic Sunnah. It is a tremendous walayah and a noble care, with which Allah has singled out His believing servants, His obedient party and His God-fearing allies (awliya').

text.ar: وَهَذَا التَّوَلِّي الْخَاصُّ يَقْتَضِي عِنَايَتَهُ وَلُطْفَهُ بِعِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَتَوْفِيقَهُمْ بِالتَّرْبِيَةِ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ وَالْبُعْدِ عَنْ سُبُلِ الضَّلَالِ وَالْخُسْرَانِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿ٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُخۡرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّٰغُوتُ يُخۡرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِۗ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ﴾ [الْبَقَرَة: ٢٥٧].
text.en: This special care entails His attention and gentleness towards His believing servants, and His granting them success by nurturing them upon faith and keeping them far from the paths of misguidance and loss. He the Exalted says: ﴾Allah is the Protector of those who believe; He brings them out of the darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve, their allies are the false deities (taghut); they bring them out of the light into the darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein forever﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:257].

text.ar: وَتَقْتَضِي غُفْرَانَ ذُنُوبِهِمْ وَرَحْمَتَهُمْ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَاۖ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡغَٰفِرِينَ﴾ [الْأَعْرَاف: ١٥٥].
text.en: It entails forgiving their sins and having mercy on them. He the Exalted says: ﴾You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy on us, and You are the best of those who forgive﴿ [al-A‘raf 7:155].

text.ar: وَتَقْتَضِي التَّأْيِيدَ وَالنَّصْرَ عَلَى الْأَعْدَاءِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ﴾ [الْبَقَرَة: ٢٨٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلنَّٰصِرِينَ﴾ [آلِ عِمْرَانَ: ١٥٠]، وَلَمَّا قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ يَوْمَ غَزْوَةِ أُحُدٍ: لَنَا الْعُزَّى وَلَا عُزَّى لَكُمْ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِلصَّحَابَةِ: «أَجِيبُوهُ»، قَالُوا: مَا نَقُولُ؟ قَالَ: قُولُوا: «اللَّهُ مَوْلَانَا وَلَا مَوْلَى لَكُمْ»، رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ فِي «صَحِيحِهِ»[1].
text.en: It entails support and victory over enemies. He the Exalted says: ﴾You are our Master, so give us victory over the disbelieving people﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:286], and He the Exalted says: ﴾Rather, Allah is your Master, and He is the best of helpers﴿ [Al ‘Imran 3:150]. When Abu Sufyan said on the day of the Battle of Uhud, “We have al-‘Uzza, and you have no ‘Uzza,” the Prophet ﷺ said to the Companions, “Answer him.” They said, “What shall we say?” He said, “Say: ‘Allah is our Master, and you have no master.’” Al-Bukhari reported it in his *Sahih*[1].

text.ar: وَتَقْتَضِي كَذَلِكَ مَنَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِدُخُولِ الْجِنَانِ وَالنَّجَاةِ مِنَ النِّيرَانِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿لَهُمۡ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۖ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ﴾ [الْأَنْعَام: ١٢٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ (٣٠) نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ (٣١) نُزُلٗا مِّنۡ غَفُورٖ رَّحِيمٖ﴾ [فُصِّلَت: ٣٠ ـ ٣٢].
text.en: It likewise entails His favour upon them on the Day of Resurrection by admitting them into the Gardens and saving them from the Fire. He the Exalted says: ﴾For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord, and He will be their Protector because of what they used to do﴿ [al-An‘am 6:127], and He the Exalted says: ﴾Indeed, those who have said, “Our Lord is Allah,” and then remained steadfast, the angels will descend upon them: “Do not fear and do not grieve, but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised (30) We are your allies in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. You will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you ask for (31) as a hospitality from One Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful”﴿ [Fussilat 41:30–32].

text.ar: وَقَدْ بَيَّنَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي نَالَ بِهَا هَؤُلَاءِ وِلَايَةَ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ، وَتَوَلِّيَهُ إِيَّاهُمْ بِتَوْفِيقِهِ وَتَسْدِيدِهِ وَعَوْنِهِ وَتَأْيِيدِهِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ (٦٢) ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ (٦٣) لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ﴾ [يُونُس: ٦٢ ـ ٦٤]، فَلَا تُنَالُ وِلَايَةُ اللَّهِ إِلَّا بِالْإِيمَانِ الصَّادِقِ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ فِي السِّرِّ وَالْعَلَانِيَةِ، وَالِاجْتِهَادِ فِي التَّقَرُّبِ إِلَيْهِ بِفَرَائِضِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَرَغَائِبِ الدِّينِ.
text.en: Allah, Glorified is He, has made clear in the Noble Qur'an the means by which these people attained Allah's walayah for them and His taking them into His care with His granting of success, His guidance to what is right, His help and His support. He the Exalted says: ﴾Unquestionably, the allies of Allah: no fear will be upon them, nor will they grieve (62) those who believed and were mindful of Allah (63) For them are good tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. There is no changing the words of Allah. That is the great triumph﴿ [Yunus 10:62–64]. So Allah's walayah is attained only through sincere faith, being mindful of Allah in private and in public, and striving to draw near to Him through the obligations of Islam and the recommended acts of the religion.

text.ar: رَوَى الْبُخَارِيُّ فِي «صَحِيحِهِ»[2] عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ: مَنْ عَادَى لِي وَلِيًّا فَقَدْ آذَنْتُهُ بِالْحَرْبِ، وَمَا تَقَرَّبَ إِلَيَّ عَبْدِي بِشَيْءٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا افْتَرَضْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَمَا يَزَالُ عَبْدِي يَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيَّ بِالنَّوَافِلِ حَتَّى أُحِبَّهُ، فَإِذَا أَحْبَبْتُهُ كُنْتُ سَمْعَهُ الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ بِهِ، وَبَصَرَهُ الَّذِي يُبْصِرُ بِهِ، وَيَدَهُ الَّتِي يَبْطِشُ بِهَا، وَرِجْلَهُ الَّتِي يَمْشِي بِهَا، وَإِنْ سَأَلَنِي لَأُعْطِيَنَّهُ، وَلَئِنِ اسْتَعَاذَ بِي لَأُعِيذَنَّهُ».
text.en: Al-Bukhari reported in his *Sahih*[2] from Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah said: ‘Whoever shows enmity to an ally (wali) of Mine, I have declared war on him. My servant does not draw near to Me with anything more beloved to Me than what I have made obligatory upon him, and My servant continues to draw near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him. When I love him, I am his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his hand with which he strikes and his foot with which he walks. If he asks Me, I will surely give him, and if he seeks refuge with Me, I will surely grant him refuge.’”

text.ar: وَأَفْضَلُ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ هُمْ أَنْبِيَاؤُهُ، وَأَفْضَلُ أَنْبِيَائِهِ هُمُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ، وَأَفْضَلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ هُمْ أُولُو الْعَزْمِ، وَأَفْضَلُ أُولِي الْعَزْمِ نَبِيُّنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَإِمَامُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَسَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَقَدْ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْفَارِقَ بَيْنَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ وَبَيْنَ أَعْدَائِهِ، فَلَا يَكُونُ وَلِيّاً لِلَّهِ إِلَّا مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَبِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ، وَاتَّبَعَهُ ظَاهِراً وَبَاطِناً، وَمَنِ ادَّعَى مَحَبَّةَ اللَّهِ وَوِلَايَتَهُ وَهُوَ لَمْ يَتَّبِعْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، بَلْ مَنْ خَالَفَهُ كَانَ مِنْ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ وَأَوْلِيَاءِ الشَّيْطَانِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿قُلۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي يُحۡبِبۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ﴾ [آلِ عِمْرَانَ: ٣١]، فَبَيَّنَ فِيهَا أَنَّ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الرَّسُولَ ﷺ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ، وَمَنِ ادَّعَى مَحَبَّةَ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَتَّبِعِ الرَّسُولَ ﷺ فَلَيْسَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ.
text.en: The best of Allah's allies are His prophets; the best of His prophets are the messengers; the best of the messengers are those of firm resolve (Ulu al-‘Azm); and the best of those of firm resolve is our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the Seal of the Prophets, the leader of the messengers and the master of all the children of Adam. Allah has made him the dividing line between His allies and His enemies. No one is an ally of Allah except one who believes in him and in what he brought, and follows him outwardly and inwardly. Whoever claims to love Allah and to be His ally while not following him is not one of Allah's allies; rather, whoever opposes him is one of the enemies of Allah and the allies of Satan. He the Exalted says: ﴾Say: If you love Allah, then follow me; Allah will love you﴿ [Al ‘Imran 3:31]. In it He made clear that whoever follows the Messenger ﷺ, Allah loves him, and whoever claims to love Allah but does not follow the Messenger ﷺ is not one of Allah's allies.

text.ar: وَكَثِيرٌ فِي النَّاسِ مَنْ يَظُنُّ فِي نَفْسِهِ أَوْ فِي غَيْرِهِ أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَهُوَ فِي حَقِيقَةِ الْأَمْرِ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِهِ، فَالْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى يَدَّعُونَ أَنَّهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ، وَأَنَّهُ لَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ، وَمُشْرِكُو الْعَرَبِ يَدَّعُونَ أَنَّهُمْ أَهْلُ اللَّهِ لِسُكْنَاهُمْ مَكَّةَ وَمُجَاوَرَتِهِمُ الْبَيْتَ ﴿وَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ أَوۡلِيَآءَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ﴾ [الْأَنْفَال: ٣٤].
text.en: Many people think, of themselves or of others, that they are among the allies of Allah, when in reality they are not among His allies. The Jews and the Christians claim that they are Allah's allies and His beloved ones, and that no one will enter Paradise except those who are of them. The idolaters of the Arabs claimed that they were Allah's own people because they lived in Makkah and were neighbours of the House, ﴾while they turn people away from al-Masjid al-Haram, and they are not its guardians. Its guardians are none but the God-fearing﴿ [al-Anfal 8:34].

text.ar: وَكَذَلِكَ الْمَلَاحِدَةُ مِنَ الْقَائِلِينَ بِوَحْدَةِ الْوُجُودِ أَوْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَالٌّ فِي خَلْقِهِ أَوْ مُتَّحِدٌ بِهِمْ وَأَنَّهُ لَا فَرْقَ بَيْنَ الرَّبِّ وَالْعَبْدِ، وَعِنْدَهُمْ أَنَّ هَذَا غَايَةُ التَّحْقِيقِ وَالْوِلَايَةِ لِلَّهِ، وَهُوَ فِي الْحَقِيقَةِ غَايَةُ الْإِلْحَادِ وَالتَّعْطِيلِ وَالْعَدَاوَةِ لِلَّهِ، فَلَيْسَ كُلُّ مَنِ ادَّعَى الْوِلَايَةَ وَتَظَاهَرَ بِهَا يُعَدُّ وَلِيًّا لِلَّهِ، فَأَوْلِيَاؤُهُ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْمُتَّقُونَ الْمُحَافِظُونَ عَلَى الْفَرَائِضِ وَالْوَاجِبَاتِ، وَالْمُجَانِبُونَ لِلْكَبَائِرِ وَالْمُحَرَّمَاتِ، وَمَنْ تَظَاهَرَ بِالْوِلَايَةِ وَادَّعَاهَا وَهُوَ لَا يُؤَدِّي الْفَرَائِضَ وَلَا يَجْتَنِبُ الْمَحَارِمَ، بَلْ قَدْ يَأْتِي بِمَا يُنَاقِضُ ذَلِكَ أَوْ يَزْعُمُ سُقُوطَ التَّكَالِيفِ عَنْهُ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ مَسَالِكِ أَهْلِ الِانْحِلَالِ وَطَرَائِقِ أَهْلِ الزَّيْغِ وَالضَّلَالِ فَهُوَ فِي الْحَقِيقَةِ وَلِيٌّ لِلشَّيْطَانِ، وَلَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِ وِلَايَةِ اللَّهِ فِي شَيْءٍ، فَأَهْلُ وِلَايَةِ اللَّهِ هُمْ مَنْ صَلَحَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ بِطَاعَتِهِ، وَازْدَانَتْ أَوْقَاتُهُمْ بِعِبَادَتِهِ ﴿إِنَّ وَلِـِّۧيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ﴾ [الْأَعْرَاف: ١٩٦].
text.en: Likewise the heretics who hold to the unity of existence, or that Allah is incarnate in His creation or united with them, and that there is no difference between the Lord and the servant. In their view, this is the height of spiritual realization and of walayah to Allah, while in reality it is the height of heresy, denial and enmity towards Allah. So not everyone who claims walayah and makes a show of it is counted an ally of Allah. His allies are the God-fearing believers who guard the obligations and duties and keep away from the major sins and forbidden things. Whoever makes a show of walayah and claims it while he neither performs the obligations nor avoids what is forbidden, and may even do what contradicts that, or claim that the religious obligations no longer apply to him, or follow other such ways of the dissolute and paths of the people of deviation and misguidance, is in reality an ally of Satan and has no part whatsoever among the people of Allah's walayah. The people of Allah's walayah are those whose deeds have been made righteous by obedience to Him and whose times are adorned with worship of Him. ﴾Indeed, my Protector is Allah, who sent down the Book, and He takes the righteous into His care﴿ [al-A‘raf 7:196].

title.en: al-Awwal and al-Akhir, az-Zahir and al-Batin (the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Most Near)

text.ar: وَقَدْ وَرَدَتْ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْأَرْبَعَةُ مُجْتَمِعَةً فِي مَوْضِعٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ، قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ [الْحَدِيد: ٣]، وَخَيْرُ مَا تُفَسَّرُ بِهِ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى وَيُبَيَّنُ بِهِ مَعْنَاهَا مَا وَرَدَ فِي السُّنَّةِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ فِي مُنَاجَاةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ لِرَبِّهِ بِهَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ مُنَاجَاةً تَتَضَمَّنُ بَيَانَ مَعَانِي هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ وَتَوْضِيحَ مَدْلُولَاتِهَا.
text.en: These four names occur together in a single place in the Noble Qur'an. Allah the Exalted says: ﴾He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Most Near, and He has full knowledge of all things﴿ [al-Hadid 57:3]. The best explanation of these beautiful names, and the best clarification of their meaning, is what has come in the Prophetic Sunnah of the Prophet's ﷺ intimate supplication to his Lord by these names, a supplication that contains an explanation of the meanings of these names and a clarification of what they indicate.

text.ar: رَوَى مُسْلِمٌ فِي «صَحِيحِهِ»[1] عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُنَا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مَضْجَعَنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ: «اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ».
text.en: Muslim reported in his *Sahih*[1] from Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: When we went to bed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to say: “O Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Tremendous Throne, our Lord and the Lord of all things, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Injil (Gospel) and the Furqan (Criterion), I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; You are the Ascendant, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near, so there is nothing nearer than You. Settle our debt for us and free us from poverty.”

text.ar: فَبَيَّنَ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ فِي هَذَا الدُّعَاءِ الْجَامِعِ مَعْنَى كُلِّ اسْمٍ وَنَفَى مَا يُنَاقِضُهُ، وَهَذَا أَعْلَى دَرَجَاتِ الْبَيَانِ، وَمَدَارُ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ عَلَى بَيَانِ إِحَاطَةِ الرَّبِّ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى بِخَلْقِهِ، وَهِيَ إِحَاطَتَانِ: زَمَانِيَّةٌ وَمَكَانِيَّةٌ.
text.en: In this comprehensive supplication, he (peace and blessings be upon him) explained the meaning of each name and negated whatever contradicts it, and this is the highest degree of clarification. These four names revolve around making clear the Lord's (Blessed and Exalted is He) encompassing of His creation, and this is of two kinds: in time and in place.

text.ar: فَإِحَاطَةُ أَوَّلِيَّتِهِ وَآخِرِيَّتِهِ بِالْقَبْلِ وَالْبَعْدِ، فَكُلُّ سَابِقٍ انْتَهَى إِلَى أَوَّلِيَّتِهِ، وَكُلُّ آخِرٍ انْتَهَى إِلَى آخِرِيَّتِهِ، فَأَوَّلِيَّةُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَابِقَةٌ عَلَى أَوَّلِيَّةِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَآخِرِيَّتُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ بَقَاؤُهُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَأَحَاطَتْ أَوَّلِيَّتُهُ وَآخِرِيَّتُهُ بِالْأَوَائِلِ وَالْأَوَاخِرِ، فَمَا مِنْ أَوَّلٍ إِلَّا وَاللَّهُ قَبْلَهُ، وَمَا مِنْ آخِرٍ إِلَّا وَاللَّهُ بَعْدَهُ، فَهُوَ جَلَّ وَعَلَا الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ قَبْلَهُ، وَالْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ بَعْدَهُ، وَهَذِهِ إِحَاطَةٌ زَمَانِيَّةٌ.
text.en: His firstness and lastness encompass by way of before and after: every preceding thing ends at His firstness, and every last thing ends at His lastness. The firstness of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, precedes the firstness of everything, and His lastness, Glorified is He, is His remaining after everything. So His firstness and lastness encompass all firsts and all lasts: there is no first except that Allah is before it, and no last except that Allah is after it. He, Exalted and Majestic is He, is al-Awwal (the First), so there is nothing before Him, and al-Akhir (the Last), so there is nothing after Him. This is an encompassing in time.

text.ar: وَأَمَّا الْإِحَاطَةُ الْمَكَانِيَّةُ فَقَدْ أَحَاطَتْ ظَاهِرِيَّتُهُ وَبَاطِنِيَّتُهُ بِكُلِّ ظَاهِرٍ وَبَاطِنٍ، فَمَا مِنْ ظَاهِرٍ إِلَّا وَاللَّهُ فَوْقَهُ، وَمَا مِنْ بَاطِنٍ إِلَّا وَاللَّهُ دُونَهُ، كَمَا قَالَ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ: «وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ»، فَعَلَا عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ بِظُهُورِهِ، فَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْأَعْلَى الَّذِي لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ فَوْقَهُ، اسْتَوَى عَلَى عَرْشِهِ الْمَجِيدِ، وَالْعَرْشُ سَقْفُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَأَعْلَاهَا، وَاللَّهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ، فَظَاهِرِيَّتُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ هِيَ فَوْقِيَّتُهُ وَعُلُوُّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَدَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ بِبُطُونِهِ، فَبُطُونُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ إِحَاطَتُهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بِحَيْثُ يَكُونُ أَقْرَبَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، فَهُوَ يَدُلُّ عَلَى كَمَالِ اطِّلَاعِهِ عَلَى السَّرَائِرِ وَالْخَفَايَا، وَدَقَائِقِ الْأَشْيَاءِ وَخَبَايَا الْأُمُورِ، كَمَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى كَمَالِ قُرْبِهِ وَدُنُوِّهِ، فَمَعَ عُلُوِّهِ عَلَى عَرْشِهِ فَهُوَ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ مُحِيطٌ بِهِمْ، فَلَا تُوَارِي مِنْهُ سَمَاءٌ سَمَاءً، وَلَا أَرْضٌ أَرْضًا، وَلَا يَحْجُبُ عَنْهُ ظَاهِرٌ بَاطِنًا، بَلِ الْبَاطِنُ لَهُ ظَاهِرٌ، وَالْغَيْبُ عِنْدَهُ شَهَادَةٌ، وَالْبَعِيدُ مِنْهُ قَرِيبٌ، وَالسِّرُّ عِنْدَهُ عَلَانِيَةٌ.
text.en: As for the encompassing in place, His being az-Zahir (the Ascendant) and al-Batin (the Most Near) encompasses everything apparent and everything hidden: there is nothing apparent except that Allah is above it, and nothing hidden except that Allah is nearer than it, as he (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “You are the Ascendant, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near, so there is nothing nearer than You.” So He is exalted above everything by His ascendancy; He is al-‘Aliyy al-A‘la (the Most High, the Highest), above whom there is nothing. He rose over His glorious Throne, and the Throne is the roof of all created things and the highest of them, and Allah is above the Throne. So His being az-Zahir, Glorified is He, is His being above everything and His exaltedness over it. And He is close to everything by His being al-Batin: His being al-Batin, Glorified is He, is His encompassing everything, such that He is nearer to it than it is to itself. This indicates the perfection of His awareness of secrets and hidden things, the finest details of things and the concealed aspects of matters, just as it indicates the perfection of His nearness and closeness. So despite His exaltedness over His Throne, He is near to His creation and encompasses them. No heaven hides another heaven from Him, no earth hides another earth, and nothing apparent veils anything hidden from Him; rather, the hidden is apparent to Him, the unseen is witnessed by Him, the distant is near to Him, and the secret is open before Him.

text.ar: وَإِذَا عَرَفَ الْمُسْلِمُ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءَ الْعَظِيمَةَ، وَعَرَفَ مَا تَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْكَمَالِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ وَالْإِحَاطَةِ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعَامِلَ كُلَّ اسْمٍ بِمَا يَقْتَضِيهِ مِنْ ذُلٍّ وَعُبُودِيَّةٍ.
text.en: When the Muslim knows these tremendous names, and knows the perfection, greatness and all-encompassing nature they indicate, it becomes obligatory upon him to respond to each name with the humility and servitude that it calls for.

text.ar: فَمَعْرِفَةُ أَوَّلِيَّةِ اللَّهِ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَسَبْقِهِ بِالْفَضْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ الْأَسْبَابَ كُلَّهَا تَقْتَضِي إِفْرَادَهُ وَحْدَهُ بِالذُّلِّ وَالِالْتِجَاءِ، وَعَدَمَ الِالْتِفَاتِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ أَوِ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَى سِوَاهُ، وَتَقْتَضِي التَّجَرُّدَ مِنَ التَّعَلُّقِ بِالْأَسْبَابِ وَالِالْتِفَاتِ إِلَيْهَا إِلَى التَّعَلُّقِ بِمَنْ مِنْهُ الْإِمْدَادُ وَمِنْهُ الْإِعْدَادُ، وَفَضْلُهُ سَابِقٌ عَلَى الْوَسَائِلِ وَالْأَسْبَابِ.
text.en: Knowing that Allah is first before everything, and that with His bounty and kindness He preceded all means, requires singling Him out alone for humility and seeking refuge, not turning to anyone else and not relying on anyone besides Him. It also requires freeing oneself from attachment to means and from turning to them, and attaching oneself instead to the One from whom all provision and all preparation come, and whose bounty precedes all intermediaries and means.

text.ar: وَمَعْرِفَةُ آخِرِيَّةِ اللَّهِ تَقْتَضِي أَنْ يُجْعَلَ وَحْدَهُ غَايَةَ الْعَبْدِ الَّتِي لَا غَايَةَ لَهُ غَيْرُهُ، وَلَا مَطْلُوبَ لَهُ وَرَاءَهُ، إِلَيْهِ وَحْدَهُ الْمُنْتَهَى، وَلَيْسَ وَرَاءَهُ مَرْمًى وَلَا بَعْدَهُ مَقْصِدٌ، وَتَقْتَضِي عَدَمَ الرُّكُونِ إِلَى الْأَسْبَابِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا تَنْعَدِمُ لَا مَحَالَةَ وَتَنْقَضِي بِالْآخِرِيَّةِ، وَيَبْقَى الدَّائِمُ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَهَا، فَالتَّعَلُّقُ بِهَا تَعَلُّقٌ بِمَا يُعْدَمُ وَيَنْقَضِي، وَالتَّعَلُّقُ بِالْآخِرِ سُبْحَانَهُ تَعَلُّقٌ بِالْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَبِالْبَاقِي الَّذِي لَا يَزُولُ.
text.en: Knowing that Allah is the Last requires that He alone be made the servant's goal, besides whom he has no goal and beyond whom he seeks nothing; to Him alone is the final end, and beyond Him there is no aim and after Him no destination. It also requires not relying on means, for they will inevitably cease to exist and come to an end with His lastness, while the Everlasting, the Abiding, remains after them. Attachment to them is attachment to what ceases and comes to an end, while attachment to al-Akhir (the Last), Glorified is He, is attachment to the Ever-Living who does not die, and the Abiding who does not pass away.

text.ar: وَمَعْرِفَةُ ظَاهِرِيَّتِهِ وَأَنَّهُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ يُدَبِّرُ أُمُورَهُمْ، وَتَصْعَدُ إِلَيْهِ أَعْمَالُهُمْ؛ تَقْتَضِي حُسْنَ تَوَجُّهِ الْقَلْبِ إِلَيْهِ، وَتَمَامَ الذُّلِّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَالْخُضُوعِ لِجَنَابِهِ وَعَظَمَتِهِ وَالضَّرَاعَةِ إِلَيْهِ وَحْدَهُ دُونَ سِوَاهُ ﴿ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ﴾ [الْحَجّ: ٦٢]، وَأَمَّا مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِظَاهِرِيَّةِ اللَّهِ وَعُلُوِّهِ فَإِنَّهُ ضَائِعٌ مُشَتَّتُ الْقَلْبِ، لَيْسَ لِقَلْبِهِ قِبْلَةٌ يَتَوَجَّهُ نَحْوَهَا، وَلَا مَعْبُودٌ يَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ قَصْدُهُ.
text.en: Knowing that He is az-Zahir (the Ascendant), that He is above His servants managing their affairs, and that their deeds ascend to Him, requires the heart to turn to Him well, complete humility before Him, submission to His majesty and greatness, and humble entreaty to Him alone and to no one else. ﴾That is because Allah is the Truth, and what they call upon besides Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Most Great﴿ [al-Hajj 22:62]. As for the one who does not believe in Allah's being az-Zahir and in His exaltedness, he is lost, his heart scattered; his heart has no qiblah to turn towards, and no object of worship towards which his aim is directed.

text.ar: وَمَعْرِفَةُ بَاطِنِيَّتِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَشُهُودِ إِحَاطَتِهِ بِالْعَوَالِمِ وَقُرْبِهِ مِنَ الْعَبِيدِ وَعِلْمِهِ بِالْبَوَاطِنِ وَالسَّرَائِرِ وَالْخَفِيَّاتِ تَقْتَضِي تَزْكِيَةَ النَّفْسِ وَإِصْلَاحَ السَّرِيرَةِ وَتَطْهِيرَ الْبَاطِنِ وَتَنْقِيَةَ الْقَلْبِ وَعِمَارَتَهُ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَالتُّقَى.
text.en: Knowing that He, Glorified is He, is al-Batin (the Most Near), and witnessing His encompassing of the worlds, His nearness to His servants, and His knowledge of inner matters, secrets and hidden things, requires purifying the soul, setting right one's inner self, cleansing one's inward, purifying the heart and filling it with faith and piety.

text.ar: فَفِي هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ جِمَاعُ الْمَعْرِفَةِ بِاللَّهِ وَجِمَاعُ الْعُبُودِيَّةِ لَهُ، كَمَا أَنَّ فِيهَا قَمْعًا لِلْوَسَاوِسِ الْمُهْلِكَةِ، وَالشُّكُوكِ الْمُرْدِيَةِ الَّتِي يُلْقِيهَا الشَّيْطَانُ فِي قَلْبِ الْإِنْسَانِ بُغْيَةَ إِهْلَاكِهِ وَصَرْفِهِ عَنِ الْإِيمَانِ.
text.en: In these four names lies the sum of knowledge of Allah and the sum of servitude to Him. They also suppress the destructive whisperings and ruinous doubts that Satan casts into a person's heart, seeking to destroy him and turn him away from faith.

text.ar: رَوَى أَبُو دَاوُدَ فِي «سُنَنِهِ»[2] بِإِسْنَادٍ جَيِّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي زُمَيْلٍ سِمَاكِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ: مَا شَيْءٌ أَجِدُهُ فِي صَدْرِي؟ قَالَ: مَا هُوَ؟ قُلْتُ: وَاللَّهِ مَا أَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي: أَشَيْءٌ مِنْ شَكٍّ؟ قَالَ: وَضَحِكَ، قَالَ: مَا نَجَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَحَدٌ، قَالَ: حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: ﴿فَإِن كُنتَ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقۡرَءُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ﴾ [يُونُس: ٩٤]، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي: فَإِذَا وَجَدْتَ فِي نَفْسِكَ شَيْئًا فَقُلْ: ﴿هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ [الْحَدِيد: ٣].
text.en: Abu Dawud reported in his *Sunan*[2] with a good chain from Abu Zumayl Simak ibn al-Walid, who said: I asked Ibn ‘Abbas, saying, “What is this thing I find in my chest?” He said, “What is it?” I said, “By Allah, I will not speak of it.” He said to me, “Is it something of doubt?” And he laughed and said, “No one has been spared that, until Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed: ﴾So if you are in doubt about what We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you﴿ [Yunus 10:94].” Then he said to me, “If you find something of that in yourself, say: ﴾He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Most Near, and He has full knowledge of all things﴿ [al-Hadid 57:3].”

text.ar: فَأَرْشَدَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى هَذَا الذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ لِطَرْدِ الْوَسَاوِسِ وَقَطْعِ الشُّكُوكِ.
text.en: So he (may Allah be pleased with him) directed to this wise remembrance for driving away whisperings and cutting off doubts.

text.ar: وَقَدْ وَرَدَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ «الْحَكِيمُ» فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ مَا يَقْرُبُ مِنْ مِائَةِ مَرَّةٍ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ﴾ [الْأَنْعَام: ١٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ [الْبَقَرَة: ٢٢٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ﴾ [النِّسَاء: ٢٦]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعًا حَكِيمٗا﴾ [النِّسَاء: ١٣٠].
text.en: Allah's name “al-Hakim” (the All-Wise) occurs in the Noble Qur'an close to a hundred times. He the Exalted says: ﴾And He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware﴿ [al-An‘am 6:18], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah is Almighty, All-Wise﴿ [al-Baqarah 2:228], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:26], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah is ever All-Encompassing, All-Wise﴿ [an-Nisa' 4:130].

text.ar: وَهَذَا الِاسْمُ الْعَظِيمُ دَالٌّ عَلَى ثُبُوتِ كَمَالِ الْحُكْمِ لِلَّهِ وَكَمَالِ الْحِكْمَةِ.
text.en: This tremendous name indicates that perfect judgement and perfect wisdom belong to Allah.

text.ar: * أَمَّا كَمَالُ الْحُكْمِ فَبِثُبُوتِ أَنَّ الْحُكْمَ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِهِ بِمَا يَشَاءُ، وَيَقْضِي فِيهِمْ بِمَا يُرِيدُ، لَا رَادَّ لِحُكْمِهِ، وَلَا مُعَقِّبَ لِقَضَائِهِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ﴾ [التِّين: ٨]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡتَغِي حَكَمٗا﴾ [الْأَنْعَام: ١١٤]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ﴾ [الْأَعْرَاف: ٨٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ﴾ [الْأَنْعَام: ٥٧]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِي حُكۡمِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا﴾ [الْكَهْف: ٢٦]، وَلَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَ اللَّهَ فِي حُكْمِهِ كَمَا يُرَاجِعُ النَّاسُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا فِي أَحْكَامِهِمْ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ﴾ [الرَّعْد: ٤١]، فَحُكْمُهُ فِي خَلْقِهِ نَافِذٌ لَا رَادَّ لَهُ.
text.en: * As for perfect judgement, it lies in affirming that judgement belongs to Allah alone: He judges between His servants as He wills and decrees for them as He wishes; there is none to reject His judgement and none to overturn His decree. He the Exalted says: ﴾Is not Allah the most just of judges?﴿ [at-Tin 95:8], and He the Exalted says: ﴾Shall I then seek a judge other than Allah?﴿ [al-An‘am 6:114], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And He is the best of judges﴿ [al-A‘raf 7:87], and He the Exalted says: ﴾Judgement belongs only to Allah﴿ [al-An‘am 6:57], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And He shares His judgement with no one﴿ [al-Kahf 18:26]. No one may question Allah over His judgement as people question one another over their judgements. He the Exalted says: ﴾And Allah judges; there is none to overturn His judgement, and He is swift in reckoning﴿ [ar-Ra‘d 13:41]. His judgement over His creation is carried out, and none can reject it.

text.ar: وَثُبُوتُ الْحُكْمِ لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ يَتَضَمَّنُ ثُبُوتَ جَمِيعِ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْحُسْنَى وَالصِّفَاتِ الْعُلْيَا؛ لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَكُونُ حَكَمًا إِلَّا سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا عَلِيمًا خَبِيرًا مُتَكَلِّمًا مُدَبِّرًا، إِلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ وَالصِّفَاتِ.
text.en: Affirming judgement for Him, Glorified is He, entails affirming all the beautiful names and lofty attributes, for He could not be the Judge unless He were All-Hearing, All-Seeing, All-Knowing, All-Aware, One who speaks and One who manages all affairs, along with the other names and attributes.

text.ar: وَفِي هَذَا إِبْطَالٌ لِجَعْلِ الْحُكْمِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ؛ لِأَنَّ الْحُكْمَ لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا لِكَامِلِ الصِّفَاتِ، الَّذِي لَهُ الْأَمْرُ، وَبِيَدِهِ التَّصَرُّفُ، وَتَأَمَّلْ هَذَا الْمَعْنَى فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ﴾ [غَافِر: ١٢]، وَقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ﴾ [الْقَصَص: ٧٠]، وَقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ﴾ [الشُّورَى: ١٠]، ثُمَّ قَالَ مُبَيِّنًا صِفَاتِ مَنْ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ: ﴿ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ (١٠) فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ (١١) لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ﴾ [الشُّورَى: ١٠ ـ ١٢]، أَيْ: أَنَّ الَّذِي لَهُ هَذِهِ الصِّفَاتُ هُوَ الَّذِي يَسْتَحِقُّ أَنْ يَشْرَعَ وَيُحَلِّلَ وَيُحَرِّمَ، وَجَعْلُ ذَلِكَ لِغَيْرِهِ أَظْلَمُ الظُّلْمِ وَأَعْظَمُ الْجَوْرِ ﴿أَفَحُكۡمَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ يَبۡغُونَۚ وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حُكۡمٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ﴾ [الْمَائِدَة: ٥٠].
text.en: In this lies a refutation of giving judgement to other than Allah, for judgement belongs only to the One perfect in His attributes, to whom the command belongs and in whose hand is all disposal. Reflect on this meaning in His saying, Exalted is He: ﴾So the judgement belongs to Allah, the Most High, the Most Great﴿ [Ghafir 40:12], His saying, Exalted is He: ﴾And He is Allah; none has the right to be worshipped but Him. To Him belongs all praise in the first life and the Hereafter; His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned﴿ [al-Qasas 28:70], and His saying, Exalted is He: ﴾And whatever you differ over, its judgement is with Allah﴿ [ash-Shura 42:10]. Then He said, explaining the attributes of the One to whom judgement belongs: ﴾That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I rely, and to Him I turn back (10) Originator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates from among yourselves, and mates among the cattle, multiplying you thereby. There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing (11) To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it. Indeed, He has full knowledge of all things﴿ [ash-Shura 42:10–12]. That is: the One who has these attributes is the One who deserves to legislate, to make lawful and to make unlawful, and to give that right to anyone else is the worst of wrongs and the gravest of injustices. ﴾Is it the judgement of the time of ignorance that they seek? And who is better than Allah in judgement for a people who have certainty?﴿ [al-Ma'idah 5:50].

text.ar: كَمَا أَنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ دَلَالَةً عَلَى أَنَّ مَنْ هَذَا شَأْنُهُ هُوَ الْمُسْتَحِقُّ وَحْدَهُ أَنْ يُفْرَدَ بِالذُّلِّ وَالْخُضُوعِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ﴾ [يُوسُف: ٤٠]، وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُۥۚ لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ﴾ [الْقَصَص: ٨٨].
text.en: It also shows that the One whose state is such is the only One who deserves to be singled out for humility and submission. He the Exalted says: ﴾Judgement belongs only to Allah. He has commanded that you worship none but Him. That is the upright religion, but most people do not know﴿ [Yusuf 12:40], and He the Exalted says: ﴾And do not call upon another god along with Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Him. Everything will perish except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned﴿ [al-Qasas 28:88].

text.ar: وَمِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ: «الْحَكَمُ»؛ فَفِي الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ هَانِئِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْحَارِثِيِّ: أَنَّهُ لَمَّا وَفَدَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَعَ قَوْمِهِ سَمِعَهُمْ يَكْنُونَهُ بِأَبِي الْحَكَمِ، فَدَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى هُوَ الْحَكَمُ وَإِلَيْهِ الْحُكْمُ، فَلِمَ تُكْنَى أَبَا الْحَكَمِ؟» فَقَالَ: إِنَّ قَوْمِي إِذَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِي شَيْءٍ أَتَوْنِي فَحَكَمْتُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَرَضِيَ كِلَا الْفَرِيقَيْنِ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «مَا أَحْسَنَ هَذَا فَمَا لَكَ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ؟»، قَالَ: لِي شُرَيْحٌ وَمُسْلِمٌ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «فَمَنْ أَكْبَرُهُمْ؟»، قُلْتُ: شُرَيْحٌ، قَالَ: «فَأَنْتَ أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ»، رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ وَالْبُخَارِيُّ فِي «الْأَدَبِ الْمُفْرَدِ»[1].
text.en: Among the names of Allah is “al-Hakam” (the Judge). In the hadith of Hani' ibn Yazid al-Harithi: when he came in a delegation to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his people, the Prophet heard them calling him by the kunyah Abu al-Hakam.
